Step-by-Step Application Instructions

Follow these 6 numbered steps for seamless, natural grey hair coverage in just 10 minutes:

  1. Step 1: Safety Check & Dry Beard Prep

    Complete the mandatory 48-hour allergy patch test. Ensure your facial hair is clean, dry, and unwashed for at least 12 hours so your skin’s natural barrier is intact.

  2. Step 2: Measure 1:1 Equal Portions

    Squeeze equal strips of 002 Black Brown Colourant Cream and Developer Cream into the mixing tray. Mix vigorously with the applicator brush until completely uniform in colour.

  3. Step 3: Strategic Application on Grey Areas

    Using the firm bristles, dab the cream onto the areas showing the highest concentration of grey whiskers, typically near the chin, soul patch, and sideburns.

  4. Step 4: Even Distribution with Comb Teeth

    Comb through the mustache and entire beard using the fine teeth to blend the black-brown cream evenly from root to tip, preventing patchiness.

  5. Step 5: Wait 10 Minutes for Deep Binding

    Set a timer for 10 minutes. The rich cream will penetrate coarse cuticles and lock in rich black-brown micro-pigments without dripping.

  6. Step 6: Rinse Clean & Pat Dry

    Rinse thoroughly under lukewarm running water until clear. Avoid soap or harsh cleansers immediately after rinsing. Pat dry with a dark towel to reveal natural depth.

Application Advisory: Always follow the instructions provided on the packaging for best results.

Precautions & 48-Hour Patch Test Protocol

Read and follow all safety precautions to safeguard your facial skin:

Essential 48-Hour Allergy Patch Test Protocol

  1. Select a clear 1 cm² patch of skin on the inside crease of your elbow or behind the earlobe, washing it gently with water.
  2. Combine a tiny pea-sized drop of 002 Black Brown Colourant Cream with equal Developer Cream in a clean dish.
  3. Apply the test mixture evenly onto the cleansed skin and let it dry uncovered for 48 hours.
  4. Inspect the site periodically. If any irritation, rash, redness, or itching appears, wash off immediately and do not use the product.

Important Safety Warnings

  • Do not apply if you have a tattoo or previously experienced a skin reaction to temporary black henna tattoos.
  • Never use on irritated, peeling, sunburned, or broken facial skin.
  • Avoid contact with the eyes. If product gets into eyes, rinse immediately with generous water and consult an ophthalmologist.
  • Specifically formulated for facial hair only. Do not apply to eyebrows, eyelashes, or head hair.
  • Keep tightly sealed, out of children’s reach, and stored below 30°C away from direct sunlight.

Frequently Asked Questions: Black Brown

Detailed answers to common questions about Dailyfix Black Brown beard colour:

Q: How is Dailyfix 002 Black Brown different from 001 Natural Black?

A: 001 Natural Black provides a solid, deep black finish ideal for naturally jet-black hair. 002 Black Brown infuses deep charcoal with warm dark chocolate undertones, creating a softer, more subtle effect that blends gracefully without looking stark.

Q: Will Dailyfix Black Brown turn reddish or orange in direct sunlight?

A: No. Many low-grade brown beard dyes oxidize and reveal brassy reddish or orange tones over time. Dailyfix uses high-stability micro-pigments calibrated with cool undertones to ensure your beard stays a rich, masculine black-brown for the entire 3–4 week wear.

Q: Is 002 Black Brown suitable for salt-and-pepper beards?

A: Yes, it is widely considered the ideal shade for salt-and-pepper facial hair. It seamlessly blends grey whiskers into the existing darker hair without wiping out the natural dimension that gives a mature beard its character.

Q: How quickly does Dailyfix Black Brown work on coarse grey whiskers?

A: The advanced cream formulation activates in just 10 minutes. For extremely stubborn or wiry white whiskers, you can leave the cream on for an additional 2 to 3 minutes for deeper colour saturation.

Q: Can I use beard oil after colouring with 002 Black Brown?

A: Yes! We recommend waiting 24 hours after application before applying heavy beard oils or balms to allow the micro-pigments to fully stabilize inside the hair shaft. After 24 hours, Dailyfix Beard Oil can be used daily to nourish your beard.

Q: Will this shade cause burning on sensitive cheek skin?

A: No. Dailyfix is 100% ammonia-free and infused with nourishing botanical olive extract. It is formulated specifically for coarse facial hair while respecting delicate facial skin, preventing the burning sensations common with traditional boxed hair dyes.

Q: What should I do if some cream touches my cheeks or lips during application?

A: Simply wipe it away immediately using a damp tissue or cotton pad. Because Dailyfix is non-staining and non-drip, quick removal prevents any temporary discoloration on your skin.
